Record Class OrganismBiophysicalProfile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.model.OrganismBiophysicalProfile
Record Components:
speciesIdentifier - canonical identifier of the biological population
adultBodyMassKg - mean adult individual body mass \(M_b\) in kilograms (\(\text{kg}\))
kleiberNormalizationWatts - metabolic normalization constant \(B_0\) in \(\text{W}\cdot\text{kg}^{-3/4}\)
referencePrimiparityYears - baseline reproductive onset age \(\tau_{\text{repro}}\) in Earth years
referenceLifespanYears - baseline intrinsic senescent lifespan \(\tau_{\text{life}}\) in Earth years
broodMetabolicMultiple - reproductive/gestation energetic cost as a multiple of annual basal metabolism
public record OrganismBiophysicalProfile(String speciesIdentifier, double adultBodyMassKg, double kleiberNormalizationWatts, double referencePrimiparityYears, double referenceLifespanYears, double broodMetabolicMultiple) extends Record
Allometric Biophysical Profile for Human Demographic & Metabolic Energetics.

Parameterizes basal metabolic power, ontogenetic maturation, lifespan, and reproductive stoichiometry for Homo sapiens populations using peer-reviewed metabolic ecology laws.

Academic Grounding

  • Kleiber (1932) & West, Brown & Enquist (1997, Science 276:122): Basal endosomatic metabolic power scales with adult body mass \(M_b\) as $$B_{\text{basal}}(M_b) = B_0 \cdot M_b^{3/4} \quad [\text{W/individual}]$$ with mammalian endothermic normalization \(B_0 \approx 4.24\,\text{W}\cdot\text{kg}^{-3/4}\) (\(B_{\text{basal}}(65\,\text{kg}) = 97.0\,\text{W} \approx 2000\,\text{kcal/day} = 3.06\,\text{GJ/yr}\)).
  • Brown, Gillooly, Allen, Savage & West (2004, Ecology 85:1771): Biological timescales (ontogenetic maturation \(\tau_{\text{repro}}\), intrinsic lifespan \(\tau_{\text{life}}\)) scale quarter-power allometrically as \(\tau(M_b) \propto M_b^{1/4}\).
  • Lotka (1922, PNAS 8:147) & Fischer-Kowalski & Haberl (2007): Dimensionless Exosomatic-to-Endosomatic Metabolic Ratio \(\mathcal{M} = \frac{P_{\text{watts}}/N}{B_{\text{basal}}(M_b)}\).

    • computeMetabolicRatio

      public double computeMetabolicRatio(double totalPowerWattsPerIndividual)
      Computes the dimensionless Lotka-Fischer-Kowalski Exosomatic-to-Endosomatic Metabolic Ratio \(\mathcal{M}\).

      $$\mathcal{M} = \frac{\max(B_{\text{basal}}, P_{\text{watts}}/N)}{B_{\text{basal}}(M_b)} \ge 1.0$$

      Parameters:
      totalPowerWattsPerIndividual - total somatic + exosomatic power captured per individual (\(\text{W}\))
      Returns:
      dimensionless metabolic ratio \(\mathcal{M} \ge 1.0\)
